Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-03-04. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. According to your policy, [COLL-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision... 'Collision' means the upset of your covered auto or its impact with another vehicle or object, including a parked vehicle, a pole, a guardrail, or a building."

The total payment for this claim is {PAYOUT}, and a {DEDUCTIBLE} has been applied.

What happens next? We will issue the payment to the designated payee shortly. You will receive a separate communication regarding the disbursement of funds.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us at our claims department.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
